_about: The quotation reader's money corpus (sales_engineer, 12 Nov 2026; review rounds 1-3 of the quoting fix). Every line, totals text and document the reviewer used, with the exact expected reading. kind line: linesFromText's first line {amount, qty, rate, held}; totals: totalsFromText {subtotal, vat, total}; doc: quoteFromExtracted {amount, ex (price before VAT), vat, held (the price is not taken: the supplier types it)}. want: the reviewer's intended ex-VAT total, where stated. main: main at 2cc9d1017, for the record. a_quotation_reads_every_money_case_as_the_corpus_says.test.ts enforces every row and the reader's principle: never a total smaller than main's unless the file states the figure used (the note says which), never a figure other than the intended one (held instead).
